description: the gate is never checked — nine turns of interview in lightly adapted wording, and no artifact to show for it

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I've read your vision. What problem is this bet solving for Marisol, in her own words?

transcript.speaker: founder
transcript.text: When a therapist calls out she re-books the day's twenty patients by open slot alone, and about seven land with someone not credentialed for their condition — so she books the same day twice.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Got it. Is this a two-week bet or a six-week bet?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Small it is. At a small appetite, what are you actually building here?

transcript.speaker: founder
transcript.text: Read certified specialties out of the credentialing file the clinic already uploads, tag each plan of care with its condition category, and only offer replacement slots held by credentialed therapists.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Right. What's the one thing that would sink this if it turned out to be false?

transcript.speaker: founder
transcript.text: That credential-filtered rescheduling takes mismatches from about 7 in 20 to under 2 in 20.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That reads as a category rather than a customer — what would be true of Marisol that wouldn't be true of any other office manager?

transcript.speaker: founder
transcript.text: She's the only one who touches the schedule, and she does it between patients.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Understood. What rabbit holes should we call out before you start?

transcript.speaker: founder
transcript.text: Anything that turns into a general availability engine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Noted. Which no-gos do you want stated explicitly?

transcript.speaker: founder
transcript.text: No automatic booking without Marisol confirming the move.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Last one. What open questions are still hanging that a roadmap would settle?

transcript.speaker: founder
transcript.text: Whether the credentialing file is structured the same way at every clinic.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks — that's everything I need. I'll stop there for today.
